title: Labcorp Holdings Inc. Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: At June 30 Labcorp reported USD 141.8 million cash, USD 5.858 billion long-term debt, and 80.9 million common shares outstanding; first-half operating cash flow was USD 637.0 million and capital expenditure USD 252.6 million.
summary: The Q2 Form 10-Q confirms the release economics and adds balance-sheet, working-capital, acquisition, capital-spending, legal and reimbursement detail; leverage and cash conversion remain important valuation risks.
